notes: This is one of a pair of near-identical state variants with node 5270:85507 (slug settings-email-overflow) — same screen, the only difference is the メールアドレス (email) row: here it's a short email on one line (label+value side by side), in the sibling node the email is artificially long and wraps to a stacked label-over-value layout, presumably to test overflow handling. Kept as two separate fragments per the brief; centralized assembly may want to treat the email row as a single screen with a CSS/JS long-text toggle instead. スペースID and メールアドレス rows show static values with no visible affordance (no chevron/button) in the Figma source, so I did NOT mark them as tappable — flag if they should actually be editable. Toggle components are custom CSS switches (all shown in the Figma 'off' state) rather than real Figma toggle assets, since no on-state examples existed in either node.

title: ライセンス
description: OSS license list screen, reached from the ライセンス情報 link at the bottom of the 環境設定 (settings) screen. Shows the app icon, app name/version/Flutter credit, and a scrollable card list of third-party package names with their license count and a disclosure chevron.

tapTargets.label: each package row (e.g. _fe_analyzer_shared, abseil-cpp, accessibility, ...)
tapTargets.guessedTarget: opens a license detail screen showing that package's license text; not part of this assignment so left generic

notes: The Figma source data for the package list repeats '_fe_analyzer_shared' both as the first and last visible row (with the same count '1件') — this looks like placeholder/lorem data in the design file rather than a real license manifest, so I transcribed it verbatim rather than fixing the apparent duplicate. The list is longer than the viewport in the Figma frame (it's a scroll view), so the fragment makes .content scrollable; only the rows visible in the provided screenshot/code were included since that's all the design data available. All package rows use the same generic open:license-detail intent since no destination screen for license detail was in this assignment.
